target.description: Managed repository workflow, branch-correct Pi continuity, evidence-backed checkpoints, scoped persistent memory, and Pi-native engineering skills.

critical_invariants_quoted: Checkpoint: verifyCheckpointChain walks ancestry; payload/projection mismatch or cycle invalidates authority.
Continuity checkpoint: blocks if mutationUncertain/pending/unresolved ledger; requires trusted Git + receipt-bound validation after latest mutation; drift after validation fails.
Managed workflow: requires continuity_prepare_work before first repo mutation; read-only / ambiguous authority / missing execution-plan binding blocks mutation.
Tool classifier: non-bash unknown tools default to mutation (fail-closed); bash not on validation allow-list or not simple-read → mutation; EXCLUDED continuity/memory tools ignored.

Memory: global-user writes require origin user-command (agent tool blocked); untrusted projects may write only session scope; empty content rejected; MemoryProviderDeferredError handled as deferred provider path.
Context pressure: advisory-only; never aborts/compacts/sends synthetic input/persists; TUI-only status.
